verdictMeaning: Taking part in a documented event earns a family glory, counted from world.participation: supplied 1, present 2, fought 3, multiplied once more for every 15 road miles the family lived from where it happened, once per person per event, and never more for a casualty. Glory lives at world.glory - not on the household, which is projected to its student whole - and every award is a sealed event in the family's record with its causes, dropped from every projection. A planted glory value reached no student, family-book or Host payload at any tick; and a class played with a planted glory came out identical to the same class without it, so nothing in the game reads glory.
specDeviation: docs/MONEY_AND_GLORY.md said household.glory. A household is projected to its own student whole, so that would have been on the wire on the first tick; it is world.glory instead, and the spec is amended to say so.
